kurz: Onions are full of sugar and sulphur compounds. Raw they are sharp; fried slowly they turn sweet and deep brown.
bild_im_kopf: Two personalities in one bulb: fiery raw, mild and sweet when fried.
was_passiert: Cutting creates sharp sulphur compounds that also sting the eyes. Heat breaks the sharpness down and brings out the sugar. Long, slow frying gives deep brown, sweet onions.
faustregeln: A sharp knife: fewer crushed cells, fewer tears.
For sweet, brown onions, patience rather than heat.

rolle.rolle: turns sweet and brown when fried
